findings.title: Attestation generator signs hard-coded successful test results
findings.evidence: test_results_data embeds SUPPORTED_WITHIN_DOMAIN, zero violations and suite pass counts (73-170); 174-180 serialize/hash them without invoking or loading test results.
findings.trigger: Run the generator on an untested or failing checkout.
findings.impact: It emits a cryptographically signed bundle presenting invented current test evidence and silicon certification.

findings.title: Artifact verification compares two stored hashes without reading the artifact
findings.evidence: Generated verifier sets artifact_hash_ok from artifact.sha256 == manifest artifact_hash; no artifact bytes or source tree are read (320-322).
findings.trigger: Modify the released source/binary while preserving an existing bundle.
findings.impact: Verifier still reports ARTIFACT HASH VERIFIED and can exit successfully; it cannot establish that the supplied implementation matches the attested artifact.

findings.title: Environment provenance is hard-coded for every host
findings.evidence: Only arch/os/release are observed; chip, filesystem, runtime, compiler, entropy and LOCAL_EMPIRICALLY_VERIFIED_SILICON are literals (188-194).
findings.trigger: Run generator on another host or toolchain.
findings.impact: Signed environment evidence misidentifies hardware/compiler/provenance, invalidating reproducibility claims.

findings.title: F60 numerator can overflow before applying the advertised score cap
findings.evidence: Five unconstrained u64 parameters are multiplied into u128 at 144-148; final cap is applied only at 157.
findings.trigger: Call public compute_score_f60 with g=l=a=b=p=100000000 (100 in F60 units): product is 10^40, above u128 capacity.
findings.impact: Debug builds panic; release builds wrap and may return an incorrect bounded score rather than saturating at 1000. No production caller found in targeted references.

findings.title: Watchdog uses a predictable writable script path
findings.evidence: open("/tmp/alert_v5.scpt", "w") follows symlinks and later os.system executes the same shared path (21-24).
findings.trigger: Another local user precreates the path as a symlink before this PoC runs, or swaps its contents between write and osascript.
findings.impact: Can overwrite a file writable by the runner or execute attacker-chosen AppleScript with runner privileges.
